scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let me take you away to
a distant spiritual place,
a land of exotic mystery,
my hometown Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
让我带你去一个遥远、宁静而神秘的异域之地，我的家乡哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text: About Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 了解哎哟泰雅

scripts.text: Go to Ayothaya.
scripts.translation: 前往哎哟泰雅

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
We Ayothayans are a pious people who value peace and sincerity. We endeavor to lead simple, yet noble, lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们哎哟泰雅人信仰虔诚，珍视和平与真诚。
我们追求简朴而高尚的生活，与自然和谐相处。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Our traditional cuisine is world famous. It's no surprise when we serve dishes like Tom Yum Goong, made of Shrimp, Lemon and Chillies, which has a tantalizing aroma and flavor beyond imagining.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我们的传统美食举世闻名，这可不是浪得虚名。
就说泰式BBQ吧，用虾、柠檬和辣椒做成，香气和滋味都诱人得难以想象。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
For those who crave adventure, there is an age old story about the Sa-mhing Tiger, an evil creature that haunts our temple ruins.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
喜欢冒险的话，我们这里还有一个古老传说。
邪恶的萨姆辛虎，会在寺庙废墟里出没。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hahh! Hoo! Hahh!
No man alive can resist the
call of this beautiful land.
Midgardians are
always welcome!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
谁能抗拒这片美丽土地的召唤呢？
我们永远欢迎米德加尔特的朋友！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah, you must pay 10,000 Zeny
if you wish to visit Ayothaya.
If you're ready, we can leave
right now~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
前往哎哟泰雅需要支付10,000 Zeny。
准备好的话，现在就能出发~

scripts.text: I'm ready, let's go!
scripts.translation: 准备好了，出发

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hoo! Hah!
Let us be off! Back to my
beautiful Ayothaya!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！呼！哈！
出发吧，回到我美丽的哎哟泰雅！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
I am sorry, but you do not have the 10,000 Zeny to travel to Ayothaya. Such a price is nothing compared to the experiences that await you!
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
抱歉，你的Zeny不足，付不起前往哎哟泰雅的10,000 Zeny旅费。
比起在那里等着你的精彩体验，这点钱可不算什么！

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Have you ever dreamed
of a beautiful place filled
with spiritual serenity? You
must have been dreaming
of Ayothaya, my friend.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
你可曾梦见一个美丽而宁静、能让心灵安歇的地方？
朋友，你梦见的一定是哎哟泰雅。

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Hoo! Hah! Hmm! Hah!
So, how did you like Ayothaya? Did you get a chance to try Tom Yum Goong? When you're ready, I shall take you back home.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
呼！哈！嗯！哈！
哎哟泰雅怎么样？尝过泰式BBQ了吗？
准备好了，我就送你回家。

scripts.text: Go back to Alberta.
scripts.translation: 返回艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
You will be welcome to come back whenever you please. I hope that we will see each other again sometime soon. Thank you~
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
随时欢迎你回来，希望我们很快再见。
谢谢~

scripts.text:
[Aibakthing]
Ah yes. I understand that it is difficult to take leave of such a beautiful place. Do not worry
and take your time.
scripts.translation:
[艾巴克辛]
我懂，这么美的地方，当然舍不得走。
别急，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Thang]
There's an ancient,
dreadful building in
Ayothaya that no one
here dares approach...
scripts.translation:
[唐]
哎哟泰雅有座古老阴森的建筑，本地人谁也不敢靠近...

scripts.text:
[Thang]
In the past, a few curious people went inside, despite the horror stories, and never returned. What on earth could be going on inside of that place?
scripts.translation:
[唐]
以前，有些好奇的人不信那些恐怖传闻，进去后却再也没出来。
那里面到底有什么？

scripts.text:
[Thang]
However, if you want to prove your courage to others, confronting the danger inside might be a worthy challenge for an adventurer...
I think.
scripts.translation:
[唐]
如果你想证明自己的勇气，进去面对那些危险，也许是个值得冒险者一试的挑战...
我是这么想的。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hello!
I don't think
we've met before.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你好！我们以前没见过吧？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You must be
from Midgard.
After all, I know every single person living in this village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
你一定是米德加尔特来的。
村子里每个人我都认识，嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...
May I ask about the land you
come from? I'm curious about
a lot of things in the outside world.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...
能跟我说说你的家乡吗？
外面的世界，有好多事让我好奇。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
You know, like the dresses and jewelry that ladies wear in other countries, whether or not the men are good looking, what kind of songs you have, what kind of girls that guys over there like...
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
比如，别国的姑娘穿什么衣服、戴什么首饰，男人长得帅不帅，流行什么歌，还有男生喜欢什么样的女孩...

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Okay~!
Take care and
enjoy your travels!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
好~！保重，旅途愉快！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
When you go East from this
village, you will arrive at the ruins of an old shrine. It is now
a nest full of fearsome monsters.
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
从村子往东走，就能到一座古老寺庙的废墟。
如今那里成了可怕魔物的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
If you plan to venture through these ruins, you better prepare
as much as you can!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
想去废墟冒险的话，一定要做足准备！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Ah...
I wonder where
my Black Knight is~
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
啊...
我的黑骑士到底在哪里呢~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't you mean...
Knight in shining armor
riding a white horse?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你想说的难道不是...骑着白马、身披闪亮铠甲的骑士吗？

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Hmm...?
Oh, well...
I'll take them both!
Hee hee~!
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...？哦，好吧...
两个我都要！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Lalitha]
Mmm...?
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[拉利塔]
嗯...？
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Ummm.
Hmmmmm...
Ummmmm...?
scripts.translation:
[村民]
唔。
嗯嗯...
唔唔...？

scripts.text:
[Villager]
You must be
an outsider.
Yes. Yes, indeed.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你一定是外乡人。
嗯，没错。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Did you just ask
where am I going?
Why, to the Fishing Spot
just ahead. That's what
we old men do: fish.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
你问我要去哪里？
当然是前面的钓鱼点。
我们这些老头就爱钓鱼。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Hmmm...
Would you like to hear
something interesting? I've heard that someone found a ring inside
a fish he caught in the
Fishing Spot.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
嗯...
想听点有趣的事吗？
听说有人在那边钓了条鱼，鱼肚子里竟然藏着一枚戒指。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Supposedly, there are lots of stories about people finding valuables inside of the fish they've been catching there.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
在那儿钓的鱼肚子里找到宝贝，这样的故事可不少。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
If you're lucky enough,
you might even become
a millionaire.
Heh heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[村民]
运气好的话，没准能变成百万富翁呢。
嘿嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Villager]
...!?
Ah, I came into the fish market! ^666666*Sigh*^000000 It seems I went the wrong way. The Fishing Spot is on the opposite side of this village.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
...！？
哎呀，走到鱼市来了！
^666666*叹气*^000000
看来走错路了，钓鱼点在村子另一头。

scripts.text:
[Villager]
Since I'm here, it wouldn't be
a bad idea to look around. All of the seafood in this market is fresh and tasty. You'll regret it if you don't try some of this seafood
at least once.
scripts.translation:
[村民]
既然来了，逛逛也好。
这里的海鲜鲜美得很，不尝一回，一定会后悔。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Phew, isn't it
soooo hot today?
scripts.translation:
[关]
呼，今天也太热了吧？

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You must be
from Midgard, huh?
I've seen a lot of tourists
coming from there recently.
scripts.translation:
[关]
你一定是从米德加尔特来的吧？
最近我见过很多从那里来的游客。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
You'd better be really careful if you travel outside of the village. Whatever you do, don't go into
the ruins of an old shrine
in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[关]
出村旅行可得格外小心。
千万别进森林里那座古老寺庙的废墟。

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
That place is far too
dangerous to visit. Still, I hear that if you had some kind of amulet, you could go there with
a little less worry...
scripts.translation:
[关]
那里太危险了。
不过，听说带着某种护身符去，能稍微安心一些...

scripts.text:
[Kwan]
Well, anyway, it's still a really good idea to stay away from that place. I hope you enjoy visiting Ayothaya, and that you keep safe~
scripts.translation:
[关]
总之，还是离那里远些为好。
希望你在哎哟泰雅玩得开心，平平安安~

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
In Ayothaya, we have our own traditional martial arts. We, the young men of the village, practice our traditional martial arts in order to become strong.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
哎哟泰雅有自己的传统武术，村里的年轻人都靠练武强身。

scripts.text:
[Detzi]
Why don't you learn our martial arts? I guarantee that it will help you greatly in your travels.
scripts.translation:
[德齐]
要不要学学我们的武术？
保证能在旅途中帮上你不少忙。

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Hey...
You look pretty strong
You wanna challenge
me to a match?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
嘿...
看起来你挺强的，要不要跟我比一场？

scripts.text: Sure!
scripts.translation: 来吧

scripts.text: Nah~
scripts.translation: 不了~

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Ow ow ow!
I was just
kidding, man!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
哎哟，哎哟！
我只是开玩笑啊，兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
I'm not so rude as to pick fights with strangers for no reason!
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
我可没那么粗鲁，无缘无故找陌生人打架！

scripts.text:
[Eik]
Real power is developed after having thousands of matches with other people. So, don't be afraid of fighting, okay?
scripts.translation:
[艾克]
真正的实力，要与人切磋千百回才能磨练出来。
所以别害怕战斗，好吗？
